description_en: Uploads offline plain text conversation data for quality inspection in online agent scenarios. We recommend that you use the UploadDataV4 API. Compared to the UploadData API, UploadDataV4 supports only POST requests and allows a longer JsonStr
description_zh:
上传离线文本质检数据（纯文本会话）：适用于在线坐席场景。
推荐使用UploadDataV4接口。
UploadDataV4与UploadData的差异：1、V4仅支持POST请求。2、V4支持更长的JsonStr
name: UploadDataV4

parameters.help_en: The JSON string that contains all the custom parameters for this API. For more information, see the description of jsonStr properties below
parameters.help_zh: jsonStr是一个JSON字符串，里面是该接口所有的自定义参数，具体内容参见下方的jsonStr属性说明
parameters.name: json_str

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. Use this parameter to select a specific workspace when you have multiple workspaces. If you do not specify this parameter, the default workspace is used
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间Id，用于区分多业务空间场景下选择指定业务空间，默认为默认业务空间
parameters.name: base_me_agent_id
